Subject: Kickstart Vendor Enrollment: ownership, intake artifacts, PO handoff

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We (Sable Health procurement) are ready to kick off vendor enrollment for Redwood and would like to schedule a short intro call to align on: vendor intake forms, PO process (our finance cadence + Redwood's billing), and a mutual action plan (owners, timelines, success criteria).

Key constraints on our side: finance needs PO numbers by 2/24 for February cutover; legal will need a single redline pass during the week of 2/20. We estimate ~3–4 stakeholders on our side (procurement, IT security, finance).

Proposed dates/times (PST):
- Tue 2/13 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2/14 14:00–14:30

If those don't work we can be flexible. We will bring the vendor enrollment form and a preliminary procurement checklist.

Attachments: vendor-enrollment-form-sable.pdf (we'll upload before the call)

Thanks,
Marta Jimenez
Procurement Manager
Sable Health
procurement@sablehealth.com

Hi Marta — great to hear. Thanks for the constraints (very helpful). Either slot works for our team; prefer Tue 2/13 10:00 if that's still open for you.

Proposed 30-min agenda (we can tighten):
1) 5m intros + goals for session
2) 10m vendor intake & required artifacts (forms, security attestation) — owner: Monica
3) 10m PO & billing handoff (timing, invoicing, PO number flow) — owner: Aditya
4) 5m MAP next steps & owners (who owns what, proposed milestones) — owner: Logan

Pre-reads (attached):
- po-checklist-v0.1.pdf — our standard PO/finance handoff checklist
- map-draft.xlsx — quick MAP template we can fill during the call

Success criteria we aim for on the call: confirm SOW/PO owner, capture initial MAP with milestones to meet your 2/24 PO requirement, and collect any outstanding vendor artifacts so legal can start their review.

If the agenda looks good I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 2/13 10:00 PST and add dial-in + hubspot link.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai
